# Static assets

Drop files here and reference them from the app root, e.g. `/hero-video.mp4`.

Expected files:
- `hero-video.mp4` — home page hero background video (your city/hotel night footage, or any restaurant ambience video). MP4, H.264, ideally under 10MB and 1920x1080 or smaller so it loads fast.
- `hero-poster.PNG` — a single frame shown while the video loads / on browsers that block autoplay.

Vite serves everything in this folder as-is from the site root, no import needed.
